content.text: Enjoy the most with our Magical Meghalaya Trip. Meghalaya is the centre of attraction for most tourists. People from all over the world come to Meghalaya to explore its beautiful locations and make thousands of delightful memories. Shillong is the capital of Meghalaya, also very famous for its culture and beautiful places like Ward’s Lake, Shillong Golf Course, Lady Hydari Park, etc. Many tourists love to trek to see the amazing Double Decker Root Bridge which is in Cherrapunji, we will explore Meghalaya's best places in this tour package.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Observe the amazing beauty of Umiam Lake
Spend a day exploring Shillong and its outskirts
Visit the most pristine village in Asia, Mawlynnong
Enjoy boating on the crystal clear water of Dawki River
Go for a day excursion to Cherrapunji and visit its beautiful waterfalls and caves
Trek to reach the Double Decker Root Bridge

days.title: Day 1 : Pickup and Shillong
items: You will be received from Guwahati Airport by our representative.
Drive to Shillong and on the way, you will visit the amazing Umiam Lake.
Explore the market for buying local handicrafts.
Later in the evening check-in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong-Tour
items: Wake up and have a mouth-watering breakfast before you start your tour.
Visit the beautiful greenery of Ward’s Lake, and Lady Hydari Park, and spend some time clicking pictures in Shillong Golf Course.
You will also visit the Don Bosco Museum which showcases the culture of the Northeast.
Check in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 3 : Cherrapunji Tour
items: Start your day with a healthy breakfast.
Head to Cherrapunji and en route witness Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Visit gorgeous waterfalls of Cherrapunji like Nohkalikai Falls, Wei Sawdong Falls, Seven Sister Falls, Dainthlen Falls and Wahkaba Falls.
Also, explore the Mawsmai Caves and Arwah Caves.
After an exhausting day return to your hotel in Cherrapunji for a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 4 : Trekking to Double Decker Root Bridge
items: Wake up early, have your breakfast and tie your laces up.
Today you will be trekking about 3500 steps to reach the amazing Double Decker Root Bridge.
Witness the extraordinary Root Bridge and examine how the roots are tied together.
Enjoy recharging yourself with the cool water which flows beneath the bridge.
If you wish, you can further trek to see the Rainbow Falls.
Trek back to the starting point at Tyrna.

days.title: Day 5 : Dawki and Mawlynnong Tour
items: Have your delicious breakfast and head to the cleanest village in Asia.
Witness the cleanliness and the beautiful greenery of Mawlynnong village.
Also, visit the amazing Balancing Rock and the Living Root Bridge.
Witness the clean and spotless water of the Umngot River in Dawki.
You can also do boating at the Umngot River
Later, you will be taken to the campsite at Shnongpdeng riverside.
Get warm by the bonfire which is specially arranged for you.

days.title: Day 6 : Shillong-Departure
items: After your breakfast in Shnongpdeng, you will head to Shillong.
On the way, visit Elephant Falls and Shillong Peak.
Thereafter you will be dropped to Guwahati airport/ railway station with all the splendid memories of the beautiful tour.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
